Lyric mezzo-sopranos do not have the vocal agility of the coloratura mezzo-soprano or the size of the dramatic mezzo-soprano.
lyric poem: a short poem of songlike quality
lyrical: suitable for or suggestive of singing

lyrically: She danced the part of the Black Swan very lyrically.
lyricism: the property of being suitable for singing
lyricist: a person who writes the words for songs
lysine: an essential amino acid found in proteins; occurs especially in gelatin and casein
lysine intolerance: a disorder in which a lack of certain enzymes makes it impossible to digest the amino acid lysine
lysis: recuperation in which the symptoms of an acute disease gradually subside
